title: Elevator maintenance notice
script: Narrator: Good morning, everyone. This is Mr. Park from building management. Elevator 2 in the east tower will be out of service this Thursday and Friday, from 8 a.m. until 5 p.m., while technicians replace the old control panel. Elevators 1 and 3 will keep running as usual, but they may be crowded during the morning rush, so please allow extra time. If you work on the upper floors and cannot use the stairs, call extension 4410 and we will arrange a temporary solution. Thank you for your patience.
translation: 皆さま、おはようございます。ビル管理室のパークです。東棟の2号機は、古い制御盤を交換する作業のため、この木曜日と金曜日の午前8時から午後5時まで停止します。1号機と3号機は通常どおり稼働しますが、朝のラッシュ時は混雑するかもしれませんので、余裕を持ってお越しください。上の階で勤務していて階段が使えない方は、内線4410までお電話ください。仮の方法を手配いたします。ご理解とご協力をありがとうございます。

questions.question: Which elevator will be out of service?
choices: Elevator 1 in the east tower
Elevator 3 in the west tower
Elevator 2 in the east tower
All of the elevators in the building
questions.explanation: 東棟の2号機が木曜と金曜に停止する。1号機と3号機は通常どおり稼働する。

questions.question: What should people on the upper floors do if they cannot use the stairs?
choices: Use Elevator 2 with a manager's key
Call extension 4410
Wait until Monday for the repairs to finish
Send an email to building management
questions.explanation: 階上で階段が使えない人は、内線4410に電話すると述べている。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "please allow extra time"?
choices: The repairs will be finished earlier than planned.
Employees can leave work early on Friday.
Travel to work may take longer than usual.
The lunch break will be extended.
questions.explanation: 朝のラッシュ時は混雑するかもしれないので、余裕を持って来てほしいという意味。

title: Pharmacy refill reminder
script: Narrator: Hello, this message is for Ms. Ortiz about your blood pressure prescription. This is Dana from Greenfield Pharmacy. Your refill is ready, and you can pick it up any time before 6 p.m. on Saturday. We will be closed on Sunday for our monthly stock check, so please don't leave it too late. If you can't come in, we can deliver it for a small fee, but you'll need to call us by noon tomorrow to arrange that. Thank you, and take care.
translation: もしもし、オルティズ様へのお知らせです。血圧のお薬についてグリーンフィールド薬局のダナが連絡しています。お薬の補充分の準備ができています。土曜日の午後6時までならいつでも受け取りにお越しいただけます。日曜日は月に一度の在庫確認のため休業しますので、遅くならないようにしてください。来店が難しい場合は、少額の料金でご自宅までお届けできます。ただし、その手配のために明日の正午までにお電話いただく必要があります。よろしくお願いします。お大事になさってください。

questions.question: Why is the speaker calling?
choices: To cancel an upcoming appointment
To ask for payment for a missed delivery
To change the pharmacy's opening hours
To say that a prescription refill is ready
questions.explanation: 処方薬の補充分の準備ができたことを知らせるための電話。他の選択肢は話に出てこない。

questions.question: Why should the listener not leave the pickup too late?
choices: The medicine's price will rise on Monday.
The doctor will need to write a new prescription.
The pharmacy will be closed on Sunday for a stock check.
The medicine can only be picked up before noon on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 日曜日は在庫確認のため休業するので、土曜日の午後6時までに受け取る必要がある。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "you'll need to call us by noon tomorrow"?
choices: The listener must arrange home delivery by a deadline.
The pharmacy will open late tomorrow.
The medicine will arrive at the listener's home at noon.
The listener has already paid for the medicine.
questions.explanation: 自宅への配達を希望するなら、明日の正午までに連絡して手配する必要があるという意味。

title: New penguin exhibit at the zoo
script: Narrator: Thank you for visiting Riverside Zoo. Starting next Monday, our newest attraction, the Antarctic Coast exhibit, will open to visitors. It is home to twelve Magellanic penguins, which were rescued after an oil spill along the coast last year and have been cared for by our veterinary team ever since. Because the birds are still getting used to their new surroundings, the glass viewing area will be limited to thirty people at a time, and photography will be allowed only from the upper walkway. Visitors who want a closer look can book a guided feeding session at the front desk. These sessions cost a little extra, but they fill up quickly on weekends, so we recommend booking early.
translation: リバーサイド動物園にお越しいただきありがとうございます。来週の月曜日から、当園の最新の施設である「南極の海岸」展示が一般公開されます。ここには12羽のマゼランペンギンがいて、昨年、沿岸での原油流出事故から救助され、それ以来、獣医チームが世話をしてきました。鳥たちはまだ新しい環境に慣れていないため、ガラス越しの観察エリアは一度に30人までに制限され、写真撮影は上の通路からのみ許可されます。より近くで見たい方は、受付でガイド付きの給餌体験を予約できます。この体験には少し追加料金がかかりますが、週末にはすぐ満席になるので、早めの予約をお勧めします。

questions.question: What will open next Monday?
choices: A new penguin exhibit
A restaurant near the entrance
A children's playground
A boat tour along the coast
questions.explanation: 来週の月曜日に開園するのは、新しいペンギンの展示「南極の海岸」。他の選択肢は話に出てこない。

questions.question: Why is the number of visitors at the viewing area limited?
choices: The penguins are still adjusting to their new home.
The glass of the viewing area is being repaired.
Weekend visitors are not allowed to enter.
All tickets for the exhibit have been sold.
questions.explanation: ペンギンがまだ新しい環境に慣れていないため、観察エリアは一度に30人までに制限される。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "they fill up quickly on weekends"?
choices: The zoo will add more sessions on weekends.
Weekend visitors will receive free tickets.
The viewing area will be closed on weekends.
Visitors should reserve a feeding session in advance.
questions.explanation: ガイド付きの給餌体験は週末にすぐ満席になるので、早めの予約を勧めているという意味。

title: Water main shutdown notice
script: Narrator: Attention, residents of Maple Street and Cedar Avenue. The city water department will shut off water service in this area next Tuesday, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., while crews replace a section of old pipe that cracked last month. Please store enough drinking water for the afternoon. When service is restored, water may look cloudy or discolored for a few hours, so run your taps for several minutes before using the water for cooking or drinking. Businesses on Cedar Avenue that need water for production should contact the city office by Friday, because only a limited number of emergency water tanks can be delivered to those sites. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: メープル通りとシーダー通りの住民の皆さまにお知らせします。市の水道局は、先月ひび割れた古い配管の一部を作業員が取り替えるため、来週の火曜日の午前9時から午後3時まで、この地域の給水を止めます。午後の分の飲料水は十分にたくわえておいてください。給水が再開されると、数時間は水が濁ったり色がついたりすることがあるので、調理や飲用に使う前に数分間水を流してください。生産に水を必要とする事業者は、金曜日までに市役所にご連絡ください。緊急用の給水タンクは数に限りがあるため、その場所に届けられるのは限られた数だけです。ご協力をありがとうございます。

questions.question: Which area will lose water service?
choices: The downtown shopping district
The north side of the river
Maple Street and Cedar Avenue
The school district
questions.explanation: メープル通りとシーダー通り一帯の水道が止まると述べている。他の地域は話に出てこない。

questions.question: What should residents do when water service is restored?
choices: Boil all water for at least one hour
Report the color of the water to the city
Use only bottled water for a week
Run the taps for several minutes before use
questions.explanation: 復旧後の数時間は水が濁ることがあるため、調理や飲用の前に数分間水を流すよう勧めている。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "only a limited number of emergency water tanks can be delivered to those sites"?
choices: The city has run out of water for all residents.
Businesses should request a tank early because supply is limited.
Residents should share one tank with their neighbors.
The shutdown will last longer than planned.
questions.explanation: 緊急用の給水タンクは数が限られているので、事業者は早めに金曜日までに連絡すべきという含み。

title: Annual shareholder meeting: dividend
script: Narrator: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining this year's annual shareholder meeting. Before we begin the formal agenda, I'd like to report on the year's results. Revenue grew by 6 percent, mainly because of strong demand for our water filtration products in Asia. However, rising shipping costs reduced our profit margin. The board is recommending a dividend of 40 cents per share, which is slightly lower than last year's. We expect the dividend to return to its previous level once costs fall. Voting will open after this presentation. You can cast your vote online, or by returning the card you received by mail, but any card must be received by Friday.
translation: こんにちは。本年度の株主総会にご出席いただきありがとうございます。正式な議事に入る前に、本年の業績をご報告いたします。売上高は6パーセント増加しました。主な理由は、アジアにおける当社の浄水製品への強い需要です。しかし、輸送費の上昇により利益率は下がりました。取締役会は、1株あたり40セントの配当を勧めています。これは昨年よりわずかに低い額です。費用が下がれば、配当は以前の水準に戻ると見込んでいます。この説明の後、投票が始まります。オンラインで投票していただくか、郵送で届いたカードを返送していただけます。ただし、カードは金曜日までに届く必要があります。

questions.question: What is the board recommending?
choices: A higher dividend than last year
A dividend of 40 cents per share
A stock split for all shareholders
A new member for the board
questions.explanation: 取締役会は1株あたり40セントの配当を勧めている。昨年よりはわずかに低い。

questions.question: How can shareholders vote?
choices: By phone only, during the presentation
In person at the board office on Friday
Online, or by returning the card they received by mail
Only by email to the company secretary
questions.explanation: オンラインか、郵送されたカードを返送する方法で投票できる。カードは金曜日までに届く必要がある。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "However, rising shipping costs reduced our profit margin"?
choices: The company plans to stop selling products in Asia.
Sales growth did not fully lead to higher profit.
Shipping costs fell compared with last year.
Shareholders should vote against the dividend.
questions.explanation: 売上は伸びたが、輸送費の増加で利益率が下がったという逆接の意図。

title: Data center outage apology
script: Narrator: Good morning. This is Daniel Reyes from the information technology department with an update on yesterday's outage. The problem began at about 2 a.m., when a faulty cooling unit in the secondary data center overheated and forced several servers to shut down automatically. Because the backup systems had not been configured to take over the email service, staff were locked out until mid-afternoon. Email is working again and all systems have been restored, but we are not out of the woods yet, since we are still checking whether any files were corrupted. Until that check is complete, please save your work frequently. We take full responsibility for the inconvenience.
translation: おはようございます。情報技術部のダニエル・レイエスです。昨日の障害について報告します。問題は午前2時ごろ始まりました。2次データセンターの故障した冷却装置が過熱し、いくつかのサーバーが自動的に停止したのです。バックアップ系統がメールサービスを引き継ぐように設定されていなかったため、社員は午後の半ばまでメールから締め出されていました。現在メールは復旧し、すべてのシステムも元に戻っていますが、ファイルが破損していないかをまだ確認中ですので、まだ安心はできません。この確認が終わるまで、作業内容はこまめに保存してください。ご不便をおかけしたことについて、当部は全面的に責任を負います。

questions.question: What caused the outage?
choices: A faulty cooling unit caused several servers to overheat and shut down
A software update accidentally deleted the email accounts
A power cut affected the entire city
A hacking attack shut down the network
questions.explanation: 2次データセンターの故障した冷却装置が過熱し、サーバーが自動停止したことが原因。

questions.question: Why were staff unable to use email until mid-afternoon?
choices: The email server was moved to a different building.
Employees had not been given new passwords.
The backup systems had not been set up to take over the email service.
The cooling unit was still being installed.
questions.explanation: バックアップ系統がメールを引き継ぐよう設定されていなかったため、午後の半ばまで利用できなかった。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "we are not out of the woods yet"?
choices: The team has moved all servers outside the building.
The problem may not be completely resolved yet.
The outage was caused by a storm in a forest.
Employees may take the afternoon off.
questions.explanation: 「まだ安心はできない」という意味の表現。メールは復旧したが、ファイルの破損確認が続いている。

title: Inventory audit at the warehouse
script: Narrator: Attention, all warehouse and dispatch staff. Our annual inventory audit begins on Monday, and until it is finished, outgoing shipments will be limited to orders marked urgent by the sales team. External auditors will count every pallet in aisles one through twelve, and any discrepancy between the physical count and our records will be logged for review. Please do not move stock between shelves during the count, even if it seems helpful, because the auditors will be working from a snapshot taken at the start of the audit. If you find damaged goods, leave them where they are and tag them in red so the auditors can record them correctly. We expect to finish by Thursday.
translation: 倉庫と出荷部門の皆さん、ご注目ください。年に一度の在庫監査が月曜日に始まります。完了するまで、出荷は営業部が緊急と指定した注文のみに限ります。外部の監査人が通路1から12までのすべてのパレットを数えます。実際の数量と当社の記録に食い違いがあれば、検討のために記録されます。数えている間は、役に立つように見えても、棚の間で在庫を動かさないでください。監査人は監査開始時点の状態をもとに作業するためです。破損した商品を見つけたら、そのままの場所に置き、監査人が正しく記録できるよう赤いタグを付けてください。作業は木曜日までに終わる見込みです。

questions.question: What will happen to shipments during the audit?
choices: Only urgent orders will be sent out.
All shipments will be delayed until Friday.
Shipments will be sent from a different warehouse.
Dispatch will be closed to all staff.
questions.explanation: 監査期間中は、営業部が緊急と指定した注文だけが出荷される。

questions.question: What should staff do with damaged goods they find?
choices: Move them to the loading dock at once
Return them to suppliers before Monday
Sell them to employees at a discount
Leave them in place and tag them in red
questions.explanation: 破損品はそのままの場所に置き、赤いタグを付けるよう指示している。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "even if it seems helpful"?
choices: Staff should not rearrange items, even if it looks like an improvement.
Staff should count the stock more than once.
Staff can rearrange items if it saves time.
Staff should ask the auditors to help with the shelves.
questions.explanation: 棚の整理が良いことに見えても、監査開始時点の在庫状態を崩さないよう在庫を動かすなという意味。

title: Spring career fair reminder
script: Narrator: Good afternoon, students. The career services office would like to remind you of the spring career fair, which takes place in the main gymnasium next Wednesday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. More than sixty employers will attend, including several engineering firms that are hoping to fill entry-level positions. Students who wish to meet recruiters during the early session should register online before Monday, as those slots are limited. Please bring at least ten printed copies of your résumé, and dress in business attire if you plan to interview on site. Recruiters have told us that candidates who research a company in advance tend to make a stronger impression, so take time to visit company websites before the fair.
translation: こんにちは、学生の皆さん。キャリア支援室から、春の就職フェアについてお知らせします。フェアは来週の水曜日、10時から16時まで、メインの体育館で開催されます。60社を超える企業が参加し、そのなかにはエントリーレベルの職を埋めたいと考えているエンジニアリング会社もいくつか含まれています。早い時間帯の面談を希望する学生は、その枠が限られているため、月曜日までにオンラインで登録してください。履歴書は少なくとも10部印刷して持参してください。その場で面接を受ける予定がある場合は、ビジネスにふさわしい服装で来てください。企業の担当者によると、事前に会社を調べてきた学生のほうが強い印象を与える傾向があるそうです。フェアの前に企業のウェブサイトを見ておく時間を取ってください。

questions.question: What are several engineering firms hoping to do?
choices: Sell software to the university
Fill entry-level positions
Close their offices in the region
Find senior managers from other countries
questions.explanation: エンジニアリング会社数社は、エントリーレベルの職を埋めたいと考えている。

questions.question: What should students bring to the fair?
choices: Samples of their past research projects
A letter of recommendation from a professor
Their university ID and a laptop
At least ten printed copies of their résumés
questions.explanation: 履歴書を少なくとも10部印刷して持参するよう指示している。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "those slots are limited"?
choices: Only students with high grades can attend the fair.
The fair will end before 4 p.m. on Wednesday.
The engineering firms will not interview anyone.
Students should register early for the early session.
questions.explanation: 早い時間帯の枠は少ないので、月曜日より前に早めに登録するよう勧める意図。
